cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Outfeel the Room
cards.instruction: Answer every fear, sacrifice, or disappointment with one of your own that deserves more attention.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: One sleepless night before your interview is manageable. I've had six. We should rehearse in order of need, please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I need someone to ask me practice questions.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then ask me first. Start with why I left my last job, not my strengths. We have to deal with the dangerous material properly.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm scared I'll freeze on the first question.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Freezing is silence. I'm likely to cry. Please practise passing me a glass of water without making a face; then we'll attempt my greeting.

reason: Make A's expert triage and rehearsal corrections commandeer B's practice time in response to B's real fear.
